title: US–China extend trade truce by two months

timeline.title: US–China extend trade truce by two months
timeline.line: Trump–Xi summit in Washington; Nikkei +1.3%, but Hang Seng −1.6% on thin outcome
more: Bessent said Washington and Beijing agreed a two-month truce extension
UBS called it shorter than hoped for a one-year rollover, but stabilising
Hong Kong losses led by financials, materials and tech

src.title: Business Recorder — China, HK stocks slip on Trump-Xi outcome
